answers.description: Arbenger.com is the company hub for Arbenger, a tech company building and shipping products across multiple platforms (VS Code extensions, Chrome plugins, AI tools, utilities, SaaS), with live browser-based image processing tools.
answers.problem: No single place to discover, showcase, and drive users to Arbenger's products across multiple platforms.
answers.target_users: Developers discovering Arbenger products + general web users needing free online image tools.
goals: Ship polished base site + establish brand identity
Build scalable foundation for new products
Excellent SEO and Core Web Vitals from day one
principles: Monospace for structure, sans for reading
